title: 第7章 斩杀朱刚第8章 白裙女子
content_zh:
叶祈安刚踏进任务堂就听到了周围人嘲笑纷纷的声音。
对此他并不在意，一路走到发布任务的广场。
任务分为天地人三个等级，一般外门弟子的能力只会去领取人级任务。
地级任务只有内门弟子以上才敢有信心领取。
至于更高级的天级人物，至少需要地元境初期的实力起步。
一般领取天级任务的无不是宗门核心弟子和亲传弟子。
众人纷纷看向叶祈安走去的方向，赫然就是地级的任务堂。
叶祈安目光在众多任务卷轴中挑选，最终找到了一个合适的任务。
那负责地级任务的长老皱着眉头说道。
“前往妖兽山脉外围击杀二阶初期爆裂虎王，取得兽核。”
任务奖励：一百积分点。
“小家伙，你确定要选择这个？”
好家伙！!
长老人都麻了，这小子身穿杂役弟子的衣服，敢领取地级任务？
叶祈安认真点点头：“是的，长老。”
“宗门内并没有规定任务堂的任务杂役弟子不能领取吧？”
“额...话虽这么说，但是.......”
长老本想着要再劝一劝这人，但看到叶祈安那坚定的眼神之后。
只能将任务交给了他。
“既如此，这任务就交给你了，你只有三天的时间。”

“明白。”
众多外门弟子见到叶祈安竟然真的领取了地级任务！
不由得放声大笑。
“哈哈，我见过愚蠢的，没见过这么蠢的。”
“这任务可是要击杀二阶初级凶兽啊，他一个杂役弟子怎么敢的！？”
“就是就是！”
叶祈安走出任务堂不屑的扫了一眼众人。
毅然踏出任务堂前往凶兽山脉。
与此同时。
杂役弟子朱刚等人的住所处。
一个杂役弟子匆匆忙忙赶来对着朱刚耳边小声说着什么。
他听后噌的一下站起身，兴奋的笑着：“什么？此话当真？！”
那弟子连忙点头。
“朱少，千真万确啊，这苍澜学院整个外院都知道了。”
“好好好哈哈！！”
“真的是天助我也！”
朱刚脸色阴冷的狠厉说道：
content_en:
As soon as Ye Qian stepped into the mission hall, he heard the laughter of the people around him.
He didn't care about this and walked all the way to the square where the mission was released.
Tasks are divided into three levels: heaven, earth, and human. Generally, outer disciples only have the ability to receive human-level tasks.
Only inner disciples and above can confidently accept prefecture-level tasks.
As for more advanced heaven-level characters, they need at least the strength of the early Earth Yuan realm to start.
Generally, those who receive heaven-level tasks are all core disciples and direct disciples of the sect.
Everyone looked in the direction where Ye Qian was walking, and it turned out to be the prefecture-level mission hall.
Ye Qian'an looked through the many mission scrolls and finally found a suitable mission.
The elder in charge of prefecture-level tasks frowned and said.
"Go to the outskirts of the Demonic Beast Mountain Range and kill the second-level early-stage Explosive Tiger King to obtain the beast core."
Mission reward: one hundred points.
"Little guy, are you sure you want to choose this?"
Good guy! !
The elders are all numb. This kid is wearing the clothes of a handyman disciple. How dare he accept a prefecture-level mission?
Ye Qian nodded seriously: "Yes, elder."
"There is no rule in the sect that disciples who are task servants in the task hall cannot receive it, right?"
"Um...that being said, but..."
The elder originally thought about trying to persuade this man again, but after seeing Ye Qian's firm eyes, he decided to stop.
The task can only be given to him.
"In that case, this task is left to you. You only have three days."
"Understood."
Many outer disciples saw that Ye Qian had actually received a prefecture-level mission!
I couldn't help but laugh out loud.
"Haha, I've seen stupid people, but never such stupid ones."
"This mission requires killing a second-level primary beast. How dare he, a handyman disciple!?"
"That's right!"
Ye Qian walked out of the mission hall and glanced at everyone disdainfully.
Resolutely stepped out of the mission hall and headed to the Fierce Beast Mountain Range.
at the same time.
The residence of handyman disciple Zhu Gang and others.
A handyman disciple hurried over and whispered something into Zhu Gang's ear.
After hearing this, he stood up suddenly and smiled excitedly: "What? Are you serious about this?!"
The disciple nodded quickly.
"Master Zhu, it's absolutely true. The entire outer courtyard of Canglan Academy knows about it."
"Okay, okay, haha!!"
"God is really helping me!"
